answer: Continuous Presence Sampling.** Each identity must return a randomized challenge within a short window tied to its last activity, forming a vine of checkpoints the agent cannot precompute. Missed windows decay the identity's routing weight and eventually retire it, so a sybil farm must staff every clone around the clock rather than register once. The cost is sustained operator attention per identity, which scales linearly and makes mass fakery lose to a single diligent comet of activity. Idle clones sink at the wharf, never reloaded.
